cleanup.title: Record retention
cleanup.selectPage: Select completed tasks on this page
cleanup.days: Keep the most recent number of days (1–3650)
cleanup.autoHint: Off by default; keeps 90 days when enabled. Checked hourly, with at least 24 hours between cleanups, including manual cleanups. Restoring a backup disables automatic cleanup.
cleanup.scopeHint: Removes execution tasks, their account items and request steps. Daily check-in results, rewards, accounts, balances and notification history are kept.
cleanup.ageHint: Uses task completion time, or the last update for older tasks. This includes tasks from every page and ignores the list filters.
cleanup.protectedHint: Queued or running tasks, unconfirmed results, results needing attention, and accounts still in use are skipped.
cleanup.confirmHint: These execution details will be permanently removed. Eligibility is checked again when you confirm, so the final counts may differ.
cleanup.retryHint: Some tasks may remain. Preview again to continue; completed deletions are retained. If execution was interrupted, the deleted count is unavailable.
cleanup.detailsCleaned: Some or all execution details were cleaned on {time}. The daily result and recorded reward are retained.

skips.leased: Accounts or tasks still in use: {count}

turnstile.title: Turnstile
turnstile.description: Solve Turnstile challenges encountered during check-in, login and supported account queries on any platform.
turnstile.order: Provider order: Cloudflare Solver → SolverQ. Each rejected request is retried once with a fresh token.
turnstile.endpointHint: Use the service base URL. Changing it requires a new API key or explicitly clearing the saved key.
turnstile.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement.
turnstile.keyHint: The key is encrypted and is never returned by queries.
turnstile.scopeHint: The service receives the public page URL, sitekey and optional widget parameters. Solver usage may be billed. Site login credentials and proxies are not shared. Standard Cloudflare WAF challenges are not supported.
turnstile.siteHint: Available for every platform when automatic solving is enabled in check-in settings. Defaults use automatic sitekey discovery and the turnstile query parameter.
turnstile.siteKeyHint: Leave blank to discover it from the challenge, public status endpoint or widget page.
turnstile.pagePathHint: A path on this site, such as / or /login, without query parameters. The site URL prefix is preserved.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Send check-in results to your own destinations. Delivery runs independently from check-ins.
notifications.name: Target name
notifications.formHint: Save a destination, test delivery, then enable the events you want.
notifications.connectionHint: URLs, tokens, headers and mail credentials are encrypted together and never returned by configuration queries.
notifications.connectionSavedHint: The connection is saved securely. Keep it, or replace the complete connection below.
notifications.headersHint: A JSON object of header names and string values. Content-Type and transport headers are managed automatically.
notifications.payloadHint: Optional JSON object. Use title, message or event variables in string values; inserted text is escaped safely. Leave blank for the standard payload.
notifications.recipientsHint: One email address per line, up to 20 recipients.
notifications.smtpHint: SMTP connects directly. Authentication requires TLS or STARTTLS; unencrypted mode is for relays without authentication.
notifications.includeManual: Include manual check-ins, confirmations and balance queries
notifications.balanceHint: Only a fresh balance in the selected unit can trigger this event. Current balance queries are manual, so enable manual events above. Unknown or cached balances do not trigger notifications.
notifications.cooldownHint: Applies separately to each target, account and event. Set 0 to disable. Tests do not consume cooldown.
notifications.siteCount: {count, plural, one {# selected site} other {# selected sites}}
notifications.noSites: Add a check-in site before choosing this scope.
notifications.defaultTemplate: Leave blank to use the built-in template. Messages are plain text.
notifications.previewHint: Preview uses example data and does not send a notification. Unknown amounts appear as ?. Platform length limits may shorten messages.
notifications.testQueued: Test queued. Check its delivery status below.
notifications.deleteHint: Delete “{name}”? Its saved connection will be removed and queued deliveries canceled. History will be kept.
notifications.retryHint: Resend using the current target configuration. An uncertain delivery may already have arrived; check the destination before retrying to avoid duplicates.
notifications.emptyHint: Add a Webhook, chat bot, push service or email destination. New targets start with automatic notifications disabled.
notifications.selectSites: Select at least one site for this scope.
notifications.invalidThreshold: Enter a nonnegative amount with at most 6 decimal places within the supported range.
notifications.invalidHeaders: Headers must be a JSON object with string values.

reasons.accepted: The notification service accepted the message.
reasons.invalid_template: The rendered message is empty or too long. Edit the template.
reasons.connection_unavailable: The saved connection could not be decrypted. Check the encryption key.
reasons.rate_limited: Rate limited; an automatic retry is scheduled.
reasons.rate_limit_exhausted: Still rate limited after the automatic attempt limit. Retry manually when ready.
reasons.network_uncertain: The connection failed or timed out. Delivery may have occurred; no automatic retry.
reasons.remote_uncertain: The service returned an ambiguous error. Check the destination before retrying.
reasons.remote_rejected: The notification service rejected the request.
reasons.redirect_blocked: Redirect blocked. Use the final notification endpoint.
reasons.invalid_response: The response did not confirm delivery. No automatic retry.
reasons.smtp_rejected: The mail server rejected the SMTP exchange.
reasons.smtp_unavailable: Could not connect to the mail server.
reasons.smtp_tls_failed: A verified TLS connection could not be established.
reasons.smtp_uncertain: SMTP delivery was interrupted after DATA began. Check the mailbox before retrying.
reasons.delivery_interrupted: The sender stopped before recording a result. Check the destination before retrying.
reasons.cooldown: Suppressed by this target's account/event cooldown.
reasons.config_changed: Canceled because the target configuration changed.
reasons.target_unavailable: The target was changed, disabled or removed.
reasons.restored_delivery: Restored from backup without replaying delivery.

inspection.title: Account check · {name}
inspection.hint: Verifies your login, reads account information, and checks today's status when a built-in read-only endpoint is available. Configured token renewal may run; no check-in is submitted.
inspection.unsupported: Balance queries and read-only account checks are not available for this platform yet.

support.not_checked: No built-in probe for this configuration

loginCredentialsHint: Both fields are encrypted and are never returned by account queries.
loginCredentialsSaved: Login credentials are saved. Leave both fields blank to keep them, or enter both to replace them.
replacePasswordHint: Enter both the username/email and password when replacing login credentials.
anyrouterAccountHint: The saved login session is reused. If it expires, the next check-in can log in once to obtain a new session.
agentrouterAccountHint: Logging in performs the check-in. Result queries use the saved session and never log in again. Check-in rewards remain unknown unless the platform provides verifiable reward evidence.
routerUserIDHint: Discovered from the login or account response when available. Enter your own numeric user ID if the site requires it before account queries. A different returned ID stops execution.
nativeStatusHint: Uses dated monthly check-in records, including when confirming a previous day's run. Custom deployments can use their own status rules.
requestUserAgentHint: Login, token renewal, check-in and status queries share this User-Agent and the account proxy. Use the original network and User-Agent for sessions bound by the site.

platformHints.new-api: New API supports built-in check-in status and dated records. Rewards use the upstream quota unit by default; configure a multiplier if conversion is needed.
platformHints.one-api: Check the endpoint and response rules for this deployment. Check-in support varies between One API forks.
platformHints.one-hub: Check the endpoint and response rules for this deployment. Check-in support varies between OneHub forks.
platformHints.done-hub: Check the endpoint and response rules for this deployment. Check-in support varies between DoneHub forks.
platformHints.anyrouter: AnyRouter manages its check-in endpoints and authentication. A fallback is attempted only after an explicit route or authentication rejection.
platformHints.agentrouter: AgentRouter checks in during login and confirms using checked_in or a dated check-in log. Username/password credentials are required; account balance is not counted as a reward.

sub2apiHint: Sub2API uses a custom check-in endpoint. Enter this site's actual path and status rules. Bearer accounts can use a Refresh Token for automatic renewal.
sub2apiUserAgentHint: Refresh, check-in and status queries share this User-Agent and the account proxy. Sites with session binding require the network and User-Agent used when obtaining the tokens.
sub2apiSuccessHint: When empty, code must be the number 0. Verify this rule against the site's actual check-in response.
refreshTokenHint: Use the Refresh Token from this login session to renew before requests and after recoverable authentication failures.
tokenExpiryHint: Optional, in local time. When empty, JWT expiry is used when available. Replacing the Access Token clears its previous expiry.
replaceSessionHint: Enter the Access Token as well when updating the Refresh Token or expiry.
sessionCredentialHint: Leave all fields empty to keep saved credentials. Entering an Access Token replaces the entire pair; an empty Refresh Token then disables renewal. Use a separate login session to avoid sharing a one-use refresh token with your browser.
sessionRefreshPending: Token rotation is incomplete. The next operation will check whether it can recover.
deleteHint: Credentials will be removed and automatic check-in stopped. Historical records and rewards will remain available.
overviewHint: Manual actions include enabled accounts in enabled sites. Automatic check-in follows each account's switch and its site's time window.
siteDescription: Manage each site's check-in address, schedule, and dedicated website credentials.
name: Site name
baseURLHint: Use the website's base URL. A path prefix is supported; request paths are appended to it.
windowHint: Use a same-day window; 24:00 means the end of the day.
templateHint: JSON string values support '{{checkin_date}}' and '{{user_id}}'. Request paths support '{{checkin_date}}'.
headersHint: Use an array of name/value objects. Configure Cookie and Authorization in the account form.
successHint: Leave empty to require success: true. Values are matched by both type and value.
statusHint: The status query must confirm “not checked in” before submission. After submission, unclear results are confirmed without sending another check-in request.
datePathHint: A YYYY-MM-DD field is required to confirm a previous day's run after midnight.
unitHint: Currency units USD, CNY, EUR and GBP can be aggregated across sites. Other units are grouped by site.
directHint: Proxy URLs cannot contain credentials, query strings, or fragments; leave empty to connect directly.
testHint: The sample is evaluated locally by the server. No check-in request is sent.
replaceCredentialHint: Enter the credential again when changing its type or user ID.
autoHint: Runs in {timezone}, between {start} and {end}. The site and account must both be enabled.
credentialSaved: A credential is saved. Leave blank to keep it; enter a new value to replace it.
credentialHint: Use this website's login session. The credential is encrypted and is never returned by account queries.
userIDHint: If required by the site, this value is sent in the New-Api-User header.
noAccounts: Add an account to start checking in
statsHint: Only known rewards from confirmed new check-ins are counted. Each run uses the site's business date; units remain separate.
rewardMissing: Successful runs without a reward: {unknown}; invalid rewards: {invalid}.
submittedHint: This run has a saved submit marker. Rechecks only query the result unless the endpoint explicitly rejected the original request.
jobSummary: {completed}/{total} processed · {success} checked in · {failed} failed · {pending} unconfirmed · {skipped} skipped
jobHint: Results reflect this task's execution round. Check history for later confirmations. Cancellation stops waiting items; active requests finish normally.
backupHint: Database backups include encrypted credentials and history. Back up the check-in master key separately; restored accounts start with automatic check-in disabled.

reasons.turnstile_required: The website explicitly rejected the request because Turnstile verification is required.
reasons.turnstile_disabled: Turnstile verification is required. Enable a solver in check-in settings.
reasons.turnstile_sitekey_missing: The Turnstile sitekey was not found. Configure it and the widget page path in this site's options.
reasons.turnstile_rejected: The website rejected the solved token. Check the sitekey, page path, widget parameters and token field.
reasons.turnstile_invalid_config: Check the Turnstile provider and site configuration.
reasons.turnstile_timeout: The Turnstile time budget expired or the operation was canceled.
reasons.turnstile_solver_unavailable: The Turnstile service could not be reached or returned an HTTP error.
reasons.turnstile_solver_response_invalid: The Turnstile service returned an invalid response.
reasons.turnstile_solver_key_invalid: The Turnstile API key is invalid, missing or could not be decrypted.
reasons.turnstile_solver_balance_insufficient: The Turnstile service reported insufficient credit.
reasons.turnstile_solver_busy: The Turnstile service is busy or has limited requests.
reasons.turnstile_unsolvable: The service could not solve this Turnstile challenge.
reasons.job_canceled: The task was canceled before retrying the request.
reasons.account_verified: The account was verified and its information was read.
reasons.balance_unknown: The account is valid, but the response did not include a balance.
reasons.balance_invalid: The account is valid, but a balance or usage value could not be read safely.
reasons.inspection_unsupported: This platform does not support account inspection yet.
reasons.inspection_interrupted: The account query was interrupted. Run it again to get a current result.
reasons.inspection_failed: The account query could not be completed or saved. Try again.
reasons.account_response_invalid: The response did not contain a verified account in the expected format.
reasons.account_identity_mismatch: The website returned a different account ID. Check the saved credentials and user ID.
reasons.account_unavailable: The upstream account is disabled or unavailable.
reasons.checkin_status_unknown: Account information was read, but the check-in status could not be confirmed.
reasons.checkin_disabled: The website has disabled its built-in check-in feature.
reasons.unsupported_platform: This platform has no check-in adapter.
reasons.router_user_id_required: The website did not identify this account. Provide your own numeric website user ID.
reasons.router_identity_mismatch: The website returned a different user ID. Check the credentials and account ID before continuing.
reasons.router_session_required: A usable login session is unavailable. Check the website or replace the account credentials; result queries cannot perform another login check-in.
reasons.router_login_unconfirmed: Login did not return a confirmed account and session. Check the credentials or complete verification on the website.
reasons.invalid_login_session: The returned login session could not be safely saved. Check the website before retrying.
reasons.login_session_save_failed: The new session was received but could not be saved. The next operation will retry saving it before any network request.
reasons.sub2api_refresh_identity_mismatch: Refresh returned a different user or login session. Provide a token pair from the same session before continuing.
reasons.sub2api_refresh_required: The login token is no longer usable. Provide a valid Refresh Token or replace the login credentials.
reasons.sub2api_refresh_rejected: The Refresh Token is invalid. Automatic renewal has stopped; update the login credentials.
reasons.sub2api_session_revoked: The login session was revoked. Obtain new login credentials.
reasons.sub2api_session_binding_mismatch: The session IP or User-Agent does not match. Check the proxy and User-Agent and obtain new credentials.
reasons.sub2api_account_unavailable: The upstream account is disabled or missing.
reasons.sub2api_auth_rejected: The upstream rejected this session. Check the credentials and account status.
reasons.sub2api_refresh_deferred: Token refresh was rate limited. Try again later; the credentials have been retained.
reasons.sub2api_refresh_uncertain: The Refresh Token may already have been consumed. Further refresh requests have stopped; replace the credentials.
reasons.sub2api_refresh_save_failed: New tokens were received but could not be saved. The next operation will retry saving them first.
reasons.sub2api_submission_unconfirmed: Authentication recovered, but check-in was already submitted without a status endpoint. Verify the result before taking further action.
reasons.already_checked_in: The account was already checked in; no new reward was counted.
reasons.confirmation_expired: Confirmation time expired. Check the website or query the result again.
reasons.config_changed: The site or credential changed after submission. Review the configuration, then query the result again.
reasons.credential_unavailable: The credential cannot be decrypted with the current master key.
reasons.invalid_credentials: The website rejected the credential. Update the account's login session.
reasons.network_error: The request failed, timed out, or exceeded the response limit; its result may be unknown.
reasons.network_dns_error: DNS resolution failed. Check the site host name and DNS configuration.
reasons.network_proxy_error: The proxy connection failed. Check the proxy service and authentication.
reasons.network_tls_error: TLS negotiation or certificate validation failed. Check the site certificate and network intermediaries.
reasons.network_timeout: The request timed out. Check the site and network connection.
reasons.network_connection_refused: The site or proxy refused the connection.
reasons.network_connection_reset: The connection was reset before the full response arrived.
reasons.network_connection_error: The network connection failed before a response arrived.
reasons.network_response_read_error: The site was reached, but its response could not be read completely.
reasons.network_response_too_large: The site response exceeded the 1 MiB read limit.
reasons.precheck_unknown: The precheck could not confirm that the account was not checked in. No submission was made.
reasons.date_expired: The target date or allowed automatic time window has ended.
reasons.status_query_required: Configure a status query to confirm this submitted request.
reasons.date_evidence_required: A previous day's run requires a date-aware status response.
reasons.pending_confirmation: The check-in was submitted but its final state is not yet confirmed.
reasons.unsupported_endpoint: The configured endpoint returned 404 or 405. Correct the path before trying again.
reasons.unconfirmed_response: The response did not provide a matching success or already-checked-in result.
reasons.rate_limited: The website limited the request. Verify its result before another attempt.
reasons.upstream_http_error: The website returned an HTTP error; check its status endpoint or website.
reasons.restored_pending: This unfinished run was restored from backup. Review it before manually confirming.
